description: This Java source file defines a comparator for ConceptMapType objects, sorting them based on their retired and hidden status. It provides a specific ordering within the context of the OpenMRS project.

classes.name: ConceptMapTypeComparator
classes.description: A comparator class that sorts ConceptMapType objects based on their status: Regular, Retired, Hidden, or Retired and Hidden.

methods.name: compare
methods.description: Compares two ConceptMapType objects based on their computed sort weights.

methods.name: getConceptMapTypeSortWeight
methods.description: Calculates the sorting weight for a ConceptMapType object based on whether it is retired or hidden.
